-- Interpolation and layout edges: nested holes, bare-indent bodies, blanks.
effect Env
  read(String) : String

class Render(a)
  render : (a) -> String

instance renderInt : Render(Int)
  fn render(v) = "v={v}"

fn nested(name : String) : String =
  "outer {concat("inner {name} deep", read("home"))} tail"

fn multiline() : Int =
  let a = let b = 1 in let c = 2 in b + c
  a

-- The raw form is the same token and the same kind of value; only its spelling
-- differs. Its body has no holes and no escapes, so a brace is a brace and a
-- backslash is a backslash, and the indentation every line shares belongs to
-- this file rather than to the string.
fn raw() : String = r"""
  {not_a_hole} and \n
    one step further in
  """
